verdict.rationale: A government web service could publish a robots.txt, so the axis applies. However, the front-door probe records that robots.txt is absent (404) at www.sos.state.mn.us. No evidence pack item shows a robots.txt on mblsportal.sos.mn.gov or any other surface, so no agent-readable crawl policy is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
